gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed postoperative glioblastoma patients pathologically confirmed as glioblastoma;

candidate_evidence.quote: This Phase II trial tests if sonodynamic therapy (SDT)-a non-invasive treatment using ultrasound to activate a cancer-killing drug-improves outcomes for newly diagnosed glioblastoma patients.
[EXPERIMENTAL] SDT + Standard Therapy: Hematoporphyrin 5 mg/kg.Sonodynamic therapy is administered 40 hours later

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed postoperative glioblastoma patients pathologically confirmed as glioblastoma;

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Exploratory Analysis: Biomarker correlation (EGFR expression, ROS levels) with SDT response using multiplex IHC and RNA sequencing.
to activate the sonosensitizer Hiporfin® (5 mg/kg), generating cytotoxic reactive oxygen species (ROS) selectively within tumor cells.

role_evidence.quote: [PROCEDURE] Sonodynamic Therapy (SDT): SDT: Hematoporphyrin 5 mg/kg.Sonodynamic therapy is administered 40 hours later, twice a day with an interval of 10-12 hours, for 5 consecutive days.
Localized Delivery: Adults receive Hiporfin® via intra-arterial infusion (maximizing tumor uptake); children receive intravenous dosing (safety precaution).

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: ultrasound-activated generation of cytotoxic reactive oxygen species in tumour cells

role_evidence.quote: When temozolomide is administered concurrently with radiotherapy, the dose is 75 mg/m² per day, taken daily until the end of radiotherapy.
Targeted Therapy: Bevacizumab 7.5-10 mg/kg, once every 3 weeks, for a total of 4-6 courses

coder_notes: Hematoporphyrin sonodynamic therapy (focused ultrasound activation) added to standard RT + temozolomide + bevacizumab, so candidate with device_dependent true; intra-arterial route in adults coded new_route. Temozolomide and bevacizumab given in both arms as standard therapy (soc_backbone). Stratification factors are clinical (location, size, residual volume), not molecular. ROS levels coded as pharmacodynamic/target engagement because ROS generation is the stated mechanism of SDT, though timing (pre/post) is not stated; EGFR expression is exploratory correlative only. Ages include CHILD (detailed description mentions children receive IV dosing) though inclusion says age <75.
